title: Expanded Scopes for Video Rating Retrieval
summary: The videos.getRating method now officially supports the youtube.readonly scope, enabling more granular access control.
details: The OAuth 2.0 scope list for the `videos.getRating` method has been updated to include `https://www.googleapis.com/auth/youtube.readonly`. This allows developers to retrieve video ratings using a read-only scope rather than requiring the broader `youtubepartner` scope, adhering to the principle of least privilege. While `youtubepartner` remains a valid scope for this method, the addition of the read-only option is a significant improvement for applications that do not require full partner-level permissions.
